title: Quarterly cadence and OKR signal taxonomy for Private/VPC/on-prem activations
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: We lack a consistent quarterly cadence and a unified set of OKR signals for Private (VPC/on-prem) deliveries. That makes it hard to prioritize feature work, measure activation health, and coordinate handoffs between Product, Eng, Solutions, and Customer Success.

Goal: Define an operational cadence (planning -> execution -> review) and a signal taxonomy that ties sprint-level outputs to quarterly OKRs for Private deployments. Signals should be actionable, measurable, and grouped by: Activation (time-to-first-activation, activation throughput), Reliability (upgrade-failure-rate, rollback-rate, MTTR for infra incidents), Security/Compliance (audit-log-integrity, KMS-integration-completion), and Adoption (customer-enabled-count, net-new-paid-tenant conversions).

Scope: This ticket covers: 1) the cadence playbook (planning checkpoints, review ceremonies, stakeholder roster), 2) a canonical set of OKR signals with definitions, owner assignments, and data sources, 3) a lightweight dashboard spec (metrics + thresholds) for the Console and PM dashboards, 4) release gating proposals tying signals to rollout waves. Not in scope: implementation of the dashboards (tracked as ENG work) and billing/legal contractual terms.

Constraints & trade-offs: We must balance signal fidelity with instrumentation effort — prefer resume-friendly heuristics (e.g., activation-throughput sampled by tenant cohort) for Q2 and gradually increase fidelity. Some signals will initially be derived from operational logs (Datadog/BigQuery) and later migrated to persistent BI tables. There is dependency on Eng to expose certain events and on Solutions for customer cohort tagging.

Primary stakeholders: Product (Priya Desai), PM Ops (Logan Rivera), Eng (Garima Patel), Solutions/SE (Marcus Nguyen), Customer Success (Elena Ortiz), Data (Ravi Kumar).
acceptance_criteria: Cadence playbook published in Confluence with weekly planning and quarterly review templates
Signal taxonomy document with 12 defined signals, owner for each, and data source mapping
Dashboard spec (mocked) attached and reviewed by Data and Eng
Rollout gating proposal that maps signal thresholds to wave gating decisions
Stakeholder sign-off recorded from Product, Eng, Solutions, and CS
